summary: A 1995 Yorkville practice with real patient stories is a strength, but dead buttons and repeated content appear to cost you new patient bookings.

findings.problem: The top Schedule Appointment button and the hours in the header appear to link to #, and every Book My Appointment button appears to go to the contact page, so no booking form is visible.
findings.cost: A new patient who taps Schedule Appointment lands nowhere and may call the next dentist.
findings.fix: One online booking form with a confirmation.

findings.problem: All three testimonials (Noah, Lily, Tim) appear to link to the same video, and the awards cited date from 2012 to 2020.
findings.cost: Repeated proof and old awards make the practice look inactive.
findings.fix: Fresh, real reviews and current awards.

findings.problem: The practice name appears in four versions (Dr. Judy Sturm & Associates, Dr Judy & Associates, Dr. Sturm and Associates, Judy Sturm & Associates) while the domain says yorkvillesmiles.
findings.cost: Mixed names weaken search visibility and trust.

findings.problem: Hero slides appear to use a dummy.png placeholder, the page says 'open early and close late' beside Friday 8am to 3pm, and the cookie notice reads 'happy with it.Ok'.
findings.cost: Small slips make a premium Yorkville practice look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean copy, real images and exact hours.

redesign: Online booking with instant confirmation and WhatsApp.
Real reviews, current awards, one brand name.
Clean mobile layout with exact hours.
